verdict.rationale: Dover documents a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A raw API is a building block, not an SDK, and no OpenAPI spec was found to generate one from (all probed paths returned 404). Official SDKs are a fair question for a SaaS platform with an API, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
